speaker: The Drowned Hall
lines: Black water laps at the bottom step. The hall beyond is long and pillared, its floor ankle-deep.
Then the grinding starts: stone on stone, slow and regular, like a mill wheel turning.
A STONE SENTINEL rounds the far pillar, walking its patrol. Blank face. Runes glowing on its knuckles. It hasn't seen you yet.

choices.text: Duck behind the toppled statue and wait for it to pass.

minigame.title: Hide from the Sentinel
minigame.intro: It walks its patrol, pausing to listen. If it hears you, it will not stop.
